ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Quranic command 'Qum fa-andhir'?
ai.summary: This verse marks the transition of the Prophet Muhammad from the initial period of silent revelation to active public proclamation, establishing the foundational duty of *tabligh* (conveyance). In Shia exegesis, it is often viewed as a command not only for the Prophet but also for the Imams, who inherit this role of warning the community against spiritual negligence and divine wrath.
